gross_amount_passes_minimum.meaning: the gross newCampaign.amount passes the minimum reward validation before fees are deducted
gross_amount_passes_minimum.checkpoint: before fee deduction and before campaign creation completes

net_amount_below_gross.meaning: the net amount applied to participants after protocol fee deduction is less than the gross campaign amount
net_amount_below_gross.checkpoint: after protocol fees are deducted from the campaign amount

net_reward_at_or_above_minimum.meaning: the net reward per hour after fees applied to participants is at or above the intended minimum threshold
net_reward_at_or_above_minimum.checkpoint: after fees are deducted, at campaign creation

rewards_below_minimum_threshold_occurred.meaning: campaigns distribute rewards below the minimum intended threshold
rewards_below_minimum_threshold_occurred.checkpoint: after campaign creation with fees deducted

assumptions: The minimum reward threshold is a fixed intended value; the report gives no numeric minimum, fee rate, or concrete amounts, so the bound is represented symbolically via the net_reward_at_or_above_minimum Boolean.
The net-below-minimum outcome is potential/conditional, not asserted as observed.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric minimum threshold, fee rate, or concrete gross/net amounts, so the bounded relation cannot be expressed with numeric operands; the threshold comparison is carried by a grounded Boolean.
Report does not specify whether the net-below-minimum outcome is observed or only conditional; modality is preserved as potential.

limitations: The threshold bound is symbolic; no numeric minimum or fee rate is available from the report.
The impact is potential, so the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional scenario.
No authorization or caller condition is stated for _createCampaign.
